content.comment_body: I want to connect to a [product_name] base module and view the program while it's running. After uploading the program, I receive a prompt: 'Device in run mode, do you want to stop?'. Is it possible to monitor the program online without stopping the operating process?

Hi [user_name], If you wish to upload the program from the [product_name] device, you must stop it. However, if you have the exact same program version saved on your PC, you can monitor without stopping the device. The upload procedure itself can be confusing. What I usually do is compare my offline program to the online version, adjusting values such as timer settings to match. Once the versions are identical, I am able to monitor online. Alternatively, you could reload an older program and continue working from there. Hope this solution works for you. w

analysis.insight_summary: Users are experiencing restrictions when attempting to monitor programs online on [product_name] hardware without interrupting active operations. Uploading a program requires stopping the device, unless the same program is already available on the PC. Participants express dissatisfaction about the inability to perform uninterrupted online monitoring, which affects workflow efficiency in production environments.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to connect to [product_name] controller hardware for real-time program monitoring without needing to halt ongoing operations. They are seeking a process that allows seamless and non-intrusive program observation.
